{"name":"main","commit":{"sha":"be0091d1676764b0e3300898ab0ad1f135f88a46","node_id":"C_kwDORQYUldoAKGJlMDA5MWQxNjc2NzY0YjBlMzMwMDg5OGFiMGFkMWYxMzVmODhhNDY","commit":{"author":{"name":"Mason Allen","email":"masra91@live.com","date":"2026-11-21T11:41:40Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-11-21T11:41:40Z"},"message":"Page Dispatcher role Actions relationships under the existing role authorization (#3733 #14) (#3761)

Refs #3733 (#14 remainder: Dispatcher role Actions paging). This doesn't
complete #3733 and has no live-host acceptance.

## What this does

The host already produces Actions relationship pages for the Dispatcher
agent. This PR lets the existing role Details path request them, under
the same authorization. It adds no new producer, authority, lifecycle or
wire field.

- **Shared:** `isSelectedDispatcherActionsQuery` is the shared
`isRemoteInventoryQuery` plus card and source.
`isSelectedDispatcherActionsPage` composes `isRemoteAgentDetails` and
`isRemoteActionRelationshipPage`. It checks the four-key wrapper,
page-only flags, source, offset, selection when the query carries one,
and the byte cap.
- **Route** (`/api/v1/dispatcher/details`, parse only):
  - authorization still runs before parse;
  - one fresh parsed object;
- per-card key sets: Actions takes `card`, `source`, `offset`,
`selection`, and Connections keeps `projectOffset`;
  - each key once, plus a digit regex;
  - anything else is `400 invalid_dispatcher_details_query`.
- **Service and client:** each copies the caller's query once, before
any await, freezes it and validates the copy. Only that copy is used
afterwards: for the producer read and page check in the service, and for
the URL and response binding in the client.
  - The client requires `expectedAgentId` and binds the response to it.
  - A page 400 maps to `unavailable` (older host).
  - 401/403 still revoke only the receipt the read ran under.
  - The M1 wrapper budget is unchanged.
- Inventory pages are never truncated: at the budget they pass, and one
byte over fails closed.
- **Renderer:** a new `RemoteDispatcherActionsPages` reuses
`SelectedActionsPage`, so the Dispatcher group shows as "Made by the
Dispatcher". It's keyed to the role pane's context and the role agent. A
page from another agent is never shown. Older hosts get a summary-only
note.
- **IPC and preload:** type widening only.

Contract:
`docs/implementation-notes/3733-role-actions-paging-contract.md`,
independently approved before implementation. The fixture prep and
evidence are under `docs/implementation-notes/`.

## Evidence (qualified)

- **Exact-head proof:** one bounded, risk-targeted local run on
`8530a956f` (product and test sources identical to this head; later
commits are docs only). Committed in
`docs/implementation-notes/3733-role-actions-impl-evidence/exact-8530-proof/`.
- vitest on 28 affected test files, **1788 tests**; `tsc --noEmit`;
scoped eslint. All exit 0.
- The tree was clean and identical before and after, and the touched
source hashes equal the commit blobs.
- This is not a full-suite run. The scope and importer map are in that
README.
- **Sealed copies vs host-local originals:** the committed logs are
path-normalized copies (`<worktree>`, `<TMPDIR>`, `<home>`), sealed by
`SHA256SUMS`. `raw-originals.sha256` lists digests of the host-local
originals. Those originals aren't in the repo, so reviewers can't verify
them independently.
- **Earlier full suite:** `full-suite.txt` (35867 tests passing) is an
owner claim recorded before the commit, not exact-head proof.
- **Mutations:** 14 distinct mutations in 15 executions. 13 of the 14
distinct ones are discriminating, including the `expectedAgentId`
binding. M12 (the renderer identity reset) is equivalent, because a role
change always unmounts the navigator, and gets no credit. M6 is credited
only through run 2, after the read-once getter controls were added. Run
1 predates those two tests. Every restore was byte-identical.
- **Changed test expectations:**
- A former RED fixture's "other selection" case now asks with a
selection.
- One byte over the budget is refused by the page validator's byte bound
(`dispatcher_details_invalid`) before the outer limit. It still fails
closed.
- The old Connections "bad query" moved from the plain Actions query
(now valid) to an Actions query carrying `projectOffset`.
- **Hosted gate:** hosted CI (the full suite on each platform) is the
acceptance gate for everything the local run doesn't cover.
